nom: TULA The Cult Classic Luminous Purifying & Brightening Gel Cleanser

avis.texte: The reviews are absolutely worth the hype - this is Tula's best product! Perfect for sensitive skin and leaves your skin glowing and smooth.
I love the "regular" Cult Classic, but The Cult Classic Luminous is even better. It leaves my skin feeling soft and clean, but not dried out and the scent is amazing!
Great cleanser! Leaves my skin feeling super clean and smooth without drying it out. Plus it smells nice too! Will definitely continue using it!

I was just about to purchase the Rich Rinse Cleanser to try when I was given the opportunity to use and review The Cult Classic Luminous cleanser. It is amazing! The smell is wonderful. The consistency of the cleanser is typical Tula. It has brightened my face just by using it for this short period. I have been a faithful Tula user for years. I started with The Cult Classic purifying face cleanser - both classic and fragrance free kinds. I know use the 24-7 moisturizers, Beauty Sleep, sunscreens and the Filter primers. The products have faded my dark spots and give a glow to my skin. This new product will definitely be in my rotation. The smell is the best part especially at night before bed. It's very calming and relaxing.
I didn't exclusively use this, but I alternated it with the original cult classic cleanser. It smells absolutely wonderful, and appears to work as well as the original!
Love the smell. It leaves skin feeling clean and soft. Does not disappoint. Definitely adding it to my every day routine.

I absolutely love this face cleanser, it smells so fresh and leaves my skin feeling so clean and clear. I typically have more oily, sensitive skin which causes me to be picky on my face products. I love that it's not a heavy product and leaves me feeling ready to conquer the world.

I have been using Tula products for a couple of years now, and I have to say I've seen a huge improvement in the over all condition of my skin. It has a much healthier appearance and more even tone. What I specifically appreciate about the new Luminous cleanser is how nicely it lathers, how good it smells, and how it leaves my face feeling after cleansing. I have combination skin, and it leaves my face hydrated and soft, but it also thoroughly cleanses my oily t-zone. It's a balanced clean, and although I received this bottle from Tula for an honest review, I will most definitely purchase in the future.

I wanted to give an honest review so I used the Luminous cleanser for a couple weeks to make sure. I absolutely love it!! From day 1 my skin literally felt brighter and cleaner. I have dry skin, especially around my nose and mouth and this totally improved the dryness. My skin LOOKS brighter! I don't know how else to describe it. I've been using the cult classic cleanser for years, but admit I don't love the scent of it. I LOVE the scent of the Luminous!! This might be my new favorite!!
My favorite face wash now with the absolute best scent! I was strongly fragrance-free but this is just delicious. And feels so luxurious on my skin. Love.
Smells amazing!!!! Seems to work just like the original cult classic just with an amazing smell! Still no better face wash than Tula whether it's the cult classic or this one!

I've tried a lot of skincare products over the years, and this TULA product has quickly become one of my favorites. The light rosewater scent is absolutely beautiful-fresh, clean, and calming without being overpowering. It makes my skincare routine feel like a little daily spa moment. Beyond the fragrance, the product leaves my skin feeling hydrated, refreshed, and incredibly soft. It absorbs well, doesn't feel heavy or sticky, and gives my skin a healthy, natural glow. If you enjoy the subtle scent of rosewater and want a product that feels as good as it smells, I highly recommend giving this one a try!

avis.titre: Cult Classic v Luminous Cult Classic
avis.texte: I will start by saying I am VERY smell sensitive so I was hesitant about this cleanser. I also shower and cleanse at night and only use water in the morning so it took a little bit longer to have a clear opinion. I have combination skin and live in a very hot/humid area, although this cleanser does have a scent, while using it, its the strongest (but only still sweet (not floral as I was expecting)), and doesn't carry that I've noticed once rinsed and skin dry. I do feel my face feels moisturized and not stripped and not tacky when only used with no products after. It also doesn't feel heavy or create a barrier that makes following skin care not absorb if more steps are applied. I usually use the cult classic, but wouldn't be disappointed to swap with this!

I've been enjoying this new cleanser more than I thought I would initially since I absolutely love the original Cult Classic. Or I should say, my skin is loving it! After using it for about 3 weeks, I am seeing noticeable results. My face seems to be glowing and much more radiant. Overall, my skin looks brighter and more hydrated. I feel it's activating the rest of my Tula skin care regimen. The texture is so silky and creamy and cleanses beautifully. I consider my skin type to be normal to oily in the T-zone. I would give it 4.5 if I could. 1/2 pt off because I was not expecting the relatively strong sweet warm fragrance. I would prefer it a touch lighter and cleaner smelling however, that is pure personal preference. I'm getting used to the scent and, it definitely hasn't been bothersome enough to keep me from using it since I'm definitely seeing the results of its formulation!

This cleanser is amazing! Leaves skin feeling luminous. My skin was super hydrated and had the best glow. The texture and scent is like no other. Takes off all makeup without harsh scrubbing. My favorite time of day to use this cleanser is in the morning. Although, it can be used AM & PM.

avis.titre: Great addition to their skincare line
avis.texte: This cleanser felt and smelled somewhat different than the others in a good way. It definitely gave a clean feeling after using, and compared to the cult cleanser in my opinion.

avis.titre: The Cult Classic, But Make It Luxurious
avis.texte: The Cult Classic Luminous is a must have! I've used The Cult Classic for a couple of years and didn't think that it could get any better, but leave it to Tula to step it up a notch! The texture of this is fantastic - it's creamy, luxurious, and smells amazing. I have combination skin with a dry T zone but oily lower face and this product works great. It doesn't contribute to oiliness but adds moisture where needed. I will 100% be using this from here on out!

Tula has done it again! This is a great new addition to the Cult Classic. The sweet floral scent is wonderful and the texture is smooth and gentle on my skin. It leaves a refreshing feeling and a bright luminous appearance.

avis.titre: A New Take On A Classic!
avis.texte: I love this new take on the Cult Classic! I have been a faithful user of the original Cult Classic and was asked to try the new Cult Classic. The scent is very uplifting and my face feels so smooth, not dry. I will be ordering the new Cult Classic from this point forward. I never would have thought that you could improve upon the Cult Classic but you did!!

avis.titre: As if the Cult Classic could get any better?
avis.texte: I have used the Cult Classic for many years. It's the only facial wash I use that can take off every ounce of makeup and not dry my skin out. The new Cult Classic Luminous has somehow made my perfect skin wash even better. Between the scent and the moisture my skin has after, it couldn't be a better product. I find the product works best if you lather the gel in your hands with a bit of water and then work onto the skin, I love the smell, the feel and the glow I have afterwards. My skin is very prone to dryness (but also oily) with a lot of products on the market right now, so once I find something I like, I stick with it. This will be one of those products.
Leaves my skin feeling great-luminous and soft! Love the refreshing smell too!
I prefer the original Cult Classic over this Luminous option, however, it did leave my skin feeling fresh and clean!

I have been a Cult Classic user for years but I love this new luminous, pink formula! The scent is beautiful! I am sensitive to scents and this one does not bother me at all. It is on the stronger side but not too sweet and does not leave a strong scent after use. My skin is glowing!

I am a long time user of the Cult Classic purifying face cleanser but thought I would give the brightening formula a try. I really love it! The scent is mild and soothing while the formula seems a bit creamier and keeps my skin hydrated. Like the original Classic, it doesn't clog my pores but leaves my face feeling soft. It also requires only a small amount so the bottle will last. I should have taken a photo at the beginning because I do feel my skin is "brighter" but could also be in my head! I highly recommend it!

I used Tula for years and have loved all of their products. The new Luminous cleanser did not disappoint. I have dry skin and it moisturized my skin while cleansing. It also smells amazing and left my skin feeling smooth. I am excited to add this to my line up of Tula products.

After being a OG cult classic user for years, I was so excited to try the new cult classic luminous! The product itself has more of a sheen/sparkle look but delivers the same great cleansing as the original. My face feels clean and not dry after using it. It does have a floral like scent, which did take me about 2 weeks to get use to, but it doesn't linger. I think this product would be great for a younger person starting to get into skin care ( between the smell and look, my niece would love this!) Either way, can't go wrong with the Tula line!

avis.titre: Luxurious take on the cult classic
avis.texte: I love the scent and it works as well as the cult classic, but didnt notice any huge different in illumination. Fun scent though!

I have been a big fan of the original Cult Classic cleanser for years. This product is an improvement on what I love about the original. First, the Cult Classic Luminous smells divine! I have never before used a cleanser that smells so good. Second, I can feel this cleanser working as I lather it. It has just a hint of a tingle. I have not noticed any perceptible difference in the appearance of my skin after a week of using this, but that is OK because I was using the original Cult Classic before, and I was happy with the results. Using the new Cult Class Luminous feels like an upgraded experience, though, and I appreciate that very much.

I have been using this product for a few weeks. My skin looks more vibrant and is definitely more even (less dry in places). It has a great texture and also smells incredible, which is such a nice feature of a facewash. It makes it feel more luxurious.

If I could, I would give this product 4.5 Stars. I've been using the original version of this cleanser (The Cult Classic) for years and have always loved it so I was excited to try the new formula. The first thing I noticed was the scent - it smells amazing and makes my skincare routine feel more luxurious. It does leave my skin feeling tighter than the original so it is a bit more drying for my combination skin. However, I do notice my complexion appears to be brighter and more radiant so that is a definite plus!

I do like the The Cult Classic Luminous. It smells really light, nice and fresh rose scent but not too much. I still like the original Cult Classic with scent or even the fragrance free Cult Classic Face Cleanser so i won't get any allergic reaction but it was good - no complaints at all!!

I have used the original cult classic for years now. I love the luminous too if smells great and balances my skin just right. I am 66 years old but have still combination skin so just right for me. Thank you letting me try it.

I love the Cult Classic Luminous cleanser. The scent is not overpowering-in fact, it adds a little oomph to my morning routine with a lovely fragrance. I get the same clean feeling the original offers. I have fairly normal skin. Since menopause, I experienced hormonal breakouts, but my Tula regimen has cleared my skin making me feel more confident. It feels wonderful. I highly recommend!

I already was a big fan of the Cult Classic Purifying Cleanser so I knew I would like this version but after trying it for a week...I am more of a fan of Luminous. The rose scent is nice and soft...not overpowering. I think it does an even better job removing my makeup. What I really like is after washing my face, my face doesn't have the dry feeling where you need to apply moisturizer right away. It also makes my skin soft and fresh. This is definitely my new favorite cleanser!
